title: Reiger Fly & Tackle’s Crossroads
setting: Nestled between a salt-crusted clam shack and a driftwood art gallery in coastal La Push, Washington, Reiger Fly & Tackle has operated as a three-generation family shop since 1947. Its weathered clapboard siding is streaked with sea spray and faint rust from decades of displayed casting reels, and the front window balances hand-tied steelhead flies beside dented saltwater tackle passed down from the shop’s original owner. The current owner, Marnie Reiger, received an unexpected 40% rent hike last week, forcing her to choose between leaning into the sustainable fly-tying supplies that draw younger eco-conscious anglers or doubling down on the classic saltwater gear that has kept loyal regulars coming for decades.

characters.name: Marnie Reiger
characters.tendencies: A third-generation shop owner torn between honoring her family’s 75-year legacy and updating the shop’s inventory to survive a sudden, steep rent hike

characters.name: Ernie Reiger
characters.tendencies: A diehard traditionalist who refuses to stock 'fad' fly-tying supplies and insists the shop only sell classic saltwater fishing gear

characters.name: Lila Marquez
characters.tendencies: A local environmental educator and fly fisher who pushes Marnie to stock sustainable fly-tying materials to attract younger, eco-conscious customers and boost the shop’s revenue

characters.name: Jake Torres
characters.tendencies: A middle-aged commercial fisherman and weekly regular who buys both classic saltwater reels and occasional fly-tying supplies for his teen son, uncertain how the shop’s changes will affect his favorite local spot
